dedupe_keys.name: building energy estimation using episcope heuristic rennes use case

description: FAIRiCUBE provides GeoJSON energy-demand estimates for individual buildings in Rennes. The July 2025 deposit applies the EPISCOPE heuristic, using construction year, building type, height and footprint to estimate energy performance. This output is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0 and belongs to the project’s neighbourhood-building-stock assessment. It can connect spatial building representations to estimated demand in energy planning simulations. Related catalogue record data-tabula-episcope-building-typologies describes the underlying typology programme, not these derived Rennes results. The public summary leaves building counts, demand units, time basis and geometry quality unknown. Rule-based estimates do not establish actual consumption or retrofit savings for a particular building. The GeoJSON was not downloaded, and compatibility with the separate Rennes XGBoost table requires checking identifiers and assumptions.
